title: Heavy Duty FRP Grating: Forklift & Vehicle Load Capacity Guide
author: ZeAll Team
excerpt: Heavy-duty FRP grating for forklift traffic, vehicle crossings and industrial platforms. 50mm/65mm pultruded grating load tables, deflection limits and pricing.
content:
1. What is Heavy Duty FRP Grating?

Heavy duty FRP grating is designed for forklift trucks, pallet jacks, hand carts and light vehicle traffic. It uses thicker bearing bars (I-bar or T-bar construction) in pultruded profiles, typically 50mm or 75mm depth. Molded grating 50mm is also available for extreme corrosion resistance with moderate wheel loads.

2. Pultruded vs Molded for Heavy Loads

Pultruded grating: unidirectional strength, higher load capacity along bearing bars, better for long spans. Available in I-bar (50mm depth) and T-bar (75mm depth). Best for: forklift platforms, truck crossings, long-span walkways. Molded heavy duty: bi-directional strength, but lower maximum load. Best for: corrosive environments with moderate wheel loads.

3. Load Capacity Table (50mm Pultruded I-bar)

UDL with safety factor 5: Span 1200mm: 500 kg/m2. Span 1500mm: 350 kg/m2. Span 1800mm: 250 kg/m2. Forklift wheel load (single wheel, 150x150mm contact, 5mm deflection): 1800N at 1200mm span. For 3-ton forklift with dual wheels, use 1800mm max span with 65mm T-bar.

4. Deflection Limits

For industrial platforms: deflection < span/200 (L/200). For forklift areas: deflection < span/150 (L/150). Always verify with project engineer. We provide free span calculations based on your specific load and span requirements.

5. Price (2026)

50mm pultruded I-bar: USD 72-95/m2. 65mm T-bar: USD 95-125/m2. 50mm molded heavy duty: USD 70-88/m2. Standard panel: 915x3660mm or 1220x4000mm. Custom widths available.

6. Applications

Forklift traffic platforms. Truck loading bays. Container yard flooring. Heavy equipment maintenance platforms. Offshore drill rigs. Steel mill walkways. Mining ore processing platforms. Warehouse mezzanines. Email sales@gratingfrp.com for free load calculations.
